svg.title: Dreams progress: packed systems and components
svg.desc: Nested system and component map. Every function is one identical square. Displayed components have readable labels and checked/identified counts. Tiny components are combined as Other within their actual system; the breakdown retains all individual names. Section allocation follows function counts with a small allowance for system headings and integer tile rounding. Full code-unit names are listed in the breakdown below.

g.text: 1,540 functions mapped to parts of Dreams | 27 names checked
One square = one function. Green: checked name. Amber: unresolved review. Gray: not reviewed.

g.title: Other: Editor camera, VR controls & comfort, Common system routines, Photos & video
Other: Strings, Engine support, Shared signal data, Shared messages, Script data, Errors & diagnostics, Common system routines

g.text: 8,011 functions still need system mapping. Full system sizes and completion remain unknown.
Same-size squares throughout. Tiny subdivisions are combined as Other; the full breakdown below keeps their names.
